summary: CalcuVerbs-Advanced redesign — frontend-only. All 18 Playwright assertions passed on 390x844 mobile viewport: home grid (module-pv-m1a/pv-m2a/bat-m1a/bat-m2a) navigates to /practice/[id]; menu toggle (lang-english / lang-mixed-en-es) correctly shows/hides Spanish references; practice screen subject carousel (subject-{i|you|he|she|it|we|they}), option carousel (option-{can|will|present|past|presentPerfect|pastPerfect}), verb-selector-button opens modal with tab-regular/tab-irregular, verb-search filtering and verb-option-{en} selection; generate-button updates sentence-affirmative, sentence-negative, sentence-question, ref-affirmative, ref-negative, ref-question and alt-negative (BAT only). All four exact expected sentence sets verified: pv-m2a presentPerfect She play ✓, pv-m1a can He break ✓, bat-m2a past They cut (+alt 'They were unable to cut.') ✓, bat-m1a will I cut ✓. Sentences remain stable until Generar is pressed (by design). Lang=EN correctly hides ref-* nodes.
critical_code_review_comments: conjugate.ts handles all requested cases correctly: 'can' → 'cannot' negative; haveForm per person; bePast for they→were; BAT alt replaces 'able to'→'unable to'; Spanish ES_MODAL.will has ser=false (no extra 'ser' word) producing 'Yo seré capaz de cortar.'; agreeParticiple applies fem/plural to the final participle word (so 'she play' → 'jugada').
DragCarousel: itemTestID is applied to each item's Pressable so tap-to-select works via testID (verified).
No deprecated expo packages detected (uses expo-haptics, expo-linear-gradient, expo-router). KeyboardAvoidingView uses react-native-keyboard-controller (modern).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844. On RN web, prefer dispatch_event('click') on Pressables (DragCarousel items + modal chips). Default verbs: pv-* defaults to M3.A-play; bat-* defaults to M2.A-cut. To test irregular verbs, open verb-selector-button, switch to tab-irregular, type search and tap verb-option-{en}. Sentences only mutate on generate-button press — do NOT expect live updates when changing subject/option/verb.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs.
